title: CYBERSIGHT’s Zenith Pro brings your bike computer to your sunglasses
content:
Cyclist
CYBERSIGHT’s Zenith Pro brings your bike computer to your sunglasses

Bike tech is still rapidly developing, with companies looking to change how we ride and push on the category in both performance and safety. To that end, Singapore brand CYBERSIGHT is part of a new wave looking to change the sports sunglasses industry with its Zenith Pro HUD smart glasses.

The Zenith Pros are not only stylish, durable, comfortable and ultra-lightweight, they display performance data and navigation directly in the rider’s field of vision, meaning there’s no looking down (HUD stands for Heads Up Display) – eyes can stay forward on the road ahead the whole time.

The tech

CYBERSIGHT isn’t a replacement for data trackers like computers and watches, instead it pairs with your device or phone to bring those stats into your line of sight in a non-invasive way, with battery life up to eight-hours, covering most of your big days in the saddle without the need for extra charge.

Display

CYBERSIGHT describes its tech as ‘the world’s first dynamic data dashboard’, which is powered by the InfinityFocus optical engine, which renders the stats in an easy-to-read way within your natural view.

There are three display modes: Standard, Dashboard and Focus, which you can select depending on which metrics you want to see, and you can adjust the size and customise the layout in the CYBERSIGHT app.

It connects to one device at a time and can display over 60 metrics depending on whether you’re tracking fields such as navigation, power data, cadence, heart rate, and even vehicle tracking when paired with a rearview radar light.

If you’re wondering how a minimalist display shows you the route without blocking your view, CYBERSIGHT uses adaptive route guidance, which shows you the turns and automatically adjusts to your movement, meaning you can see every upcoming bend without looking down.

Sound

It’s not just stats for your eyes, the Zenith Pros have built-in DirectionalSound speakers and a noise-cancelling bone conduction microphone that can cut through the wind to stay clear at speeds up to 80kmh.

Paired with live location tracking through the CYBERSIGHT app, this means that riders can use it to communicate with friends – or teammates – in real time.

The design

Tech aside, the CYBERSIGHT Zenith Pros feature an aerodynamic design inspired by falcons and the frame is made using aerospace-grade lithium-magnesium alloy, which is extra-lightweight and strong.

On top of that is Fight-Jet Coating Technology, which makes it smooth to the touch and comfortable against the skin.

The glasses are classified IP54 dust- and water-resistant, so they’re safe to wear in the rain, and the lenses are interchangeable with high-contrast silver and purple plus photochromic lenses for changing light conditions.

Discover the CYBERSIGHT Zenith Pro glasses at cybersight.sg.

Spec

  • Price: £417 / US$459 / €486.95
  • Size: 171.6mm x 160mm x 51.5mm
  • Weight: 39g
  • Resolution: 640 x 480
  • Display colour: Green
  • Field of view: 30°
  • Operating temperature: -10°C to 55°C
  • Battery life: Up to 8 hours
  • Charging time: 90 minutes
  • Charging port: USB-C
  • Interchangeable nose pads: S, M and L
  • Lens features: UV Protection, Anti-Fog, Anti-Glare, Impact Protection, Scratch Resistance
  • Compatible devices: iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Garmin watches, Garmin and Hammerhead Karoo 2/3 computers
  • Third-party accessories: Smart helmets, rearview radar lights, heart rate monitors, cadence sensors, power meters and more
